<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ko">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8"/>
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1.0"/>
<title>이지은 | LEE JI EUN</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com"/>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin/>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=DM+Sans:ital,opsz,wght@0,9..40,300;0,9..40,400;0,9..40,500;0,9..40,600;0,9..40,700;1,9..40,300;1,9..40,400&display=swap" rel="stylesheet"/>
<style>

*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{font-family:'DM Sans',sans-serif;font-weight:300;background:#f9f8f5;color:#1c1c2e;line-height:1.75;overflow-x:hidden}

/* LIGHTBOX */
.lb{display:none;position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.92);z-index:9000;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px;cursor:zoom-out}
.lb.open{display:flex}
.lb-box{position:relative;max-width:92vw;max-height:92vh;cursor:default}
.lb-box img{max-width:100%;max-height:88vh;border-radius:8px;display:block;box-shadow:0 0 60px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.lb-x{position:absolute;top:-38px;right:0;width:30px;height:30px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.15);border:1.5px solid rgba(255,255,255,.4);color:#fff;font-size:1rem;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:background .2s}
.lb-x:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.3)}

/* HEADER */
header{background:#0d1f35;color:#fff;padding:60px 40px 48px;position:relative;overflow:hidden}
header::before{content:'';position:absolute;top:-120px;right:-120px;width:480px;height:480px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(26,139,120,.18) 0%,transparent 65%);pointer-events:none}
header::after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:0;left:0;right:0;height:2px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a8b78,#25bfa8 50%,transparent)}
.h-inner{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:flex-start}
.prof-img{width:150px;height:150px;border-radius:50%;border:2.5px solid #25bfa8;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 18%;flex-shrink:0;box-shadow:0 0 0 5px rgba(37,191,168,.15);cursor:zoom-in;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}
.prof-img:hover{box-shadow:0 0 0 8px rgba(37,191,168,.22);transform:scale(1.02)}
.h-name{font-weight:300;font-size:clamp(2.2rem,6vw,3.4rem);line-height:1.05;letter-spacing:.02em}
.h-name em{display:block;font-style:normal;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(.72rem,2vw,.85rem);letter-spacing:.3em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#25bfa8;margin-top:7px}
.h-sub{margin-top:12px;font-size:.86rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.6);line-height:1.8}
.h-sub strong{color:rgba(255,255,255,.88);font-weight:500}
.h-tags{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin-top:14px}
.h-tag{background:rgba(37,191,168,.15);border:1px solid rgba(37,191,168,.3);color:#25bfa8;font-size:.72rem;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:20px}
.c-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:4px}
.c-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:.81rem;color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);justify-content:flex-end}
.c-item a{color:rgba(255,255,255,.65);text-decoration:none;transition:color .2s}
.c-item a:hover{color:#25bfa8}
.ci{width:15px;height:15px;fill:#25bfa8;flex-shrink:0}

/* MAIN */
main{max-width:860px;margin:0 auto;padding:64px 40px 80px}

/* SECTION */
.sec{margin-bottom:56px;animation:fadeUp .55s ease both}
.sec:nth-child(2){animation-delay:.05s}.sec:nth-child(3){animation-delay:.10s}
.sec:nth-child(4){animation-delay:.15s}.sec:nth-child(5){animation-delay:.20s}
.sec:nth-child(6){animation-delay:.25s}.sec:nth-child(7){animation-delay:.30s}
.sec:nth-child(8){animation-delay:.35s}.sec:nth-child(9){animation-delay:.40s}
@keyframes fadeUp{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0)}}
.sh{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-bottom:28px}
.sh h2{font-weight:600;font-size:1.05rem;color:#0d1f35;white-space:nowrap;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.sh-line{flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a8b78 0%,transparent 100%)}

/* TIMELINE */
.tl-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:160px 1fr;gap:20px;padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid #edf2f1}
.tl-row:first-child{padding-top:4px}.tl-row:last-child{border-bottom:none}
.tl-d{font-size:.78rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:400;letter-spacing:.04em;padding-top:3px;line-height:1.6}
.tl-b h3{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500;color:#0d1f35;margin-bottom:3px}
.tl-b p{font-size:.82rem;color:#6b7b8d;line-height:1.6}
.bdg{display:inline-block;background:#e6f5f3;color:#1a8b78;font-size:.71rem;font-weight:500;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:4px;margin-top:7px;letter-spacing:.03em}

/* SKILLS */
.sk-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.sk-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;padding:20px;transition:border-color .2s,transform .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.sk-card:hover{border-color:#1a8b78;transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(26,139,120,.08)}
.sk-card h3{font-size:1rem;font-weight:700;color:#0d1f35;letter-spacing:.04em;margin-bottom:5px}
.sk-desc{font-size:.74rem;color:#6b7b8d;line-height:1.5}
.sk-bar{margin-top:12px;height:3px;background:#dce8e5;border-radius:3px;overflow:hidden}
.sk-fill{height:100%;background:linear-gradient(90deg,#1a8b78,#25bfa8);border-radius:3px;animation:barIn .9s ease both}
.sk-lv{margin-top:7px;font-size:.72rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500}
@keyframes barIn{from{width:0!important}}

/* PAPERS */
.paper{padding:18px 22px;background:#fff;border-left:3px solid #1a8b78;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0;margin-bottom:14px;box-shadow:0 1px 4px rgba(0,0,0,.04);transition:border-left-width .2s,padding-left .2s,box-shadow .2s}
.paper:last-child{margin-bottom:0}
.paper:hover{border-left-width:5px;padding-left:20px;box-shadow:0 4px 12px rgba(26,139,120,.1)}
.paper h3{font-size:.9rem;font-weight:400;font-style:italic;color:#0d1f35;line-height:1.6;margin-bottom:8px;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word}
.pmeta{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pdate{font-size:.74rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500}
.plink{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;font-size:.72rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;padding:2px 9px;border:1px solid #1a8b78;border-radius:4px;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.plink:hover{background:#1a8b78;color:#fff}
.plink svg{width:11px;height:11px;fill:currentColor;flex-shrink:0}

/* PROJECTS */
.pj-list{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.pj-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;padding:18px 22px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;column-gap:14px;row-gap:6px;align-items:start;transition:box-shadow .2s}
.pj-card:hover{box-shadow:0 4px 18px rgba(26,139,120,.09)}
.pj-org{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:#e6f5f3;color:#1a8b78;font-size:.71rem;font-weight:500;padding:3px 10px;border-radius:5px;white-space:nowrap;height:fit-content;margin-top:1px}
.pj-body{min-width:0}
.pj-title{font-size:.86rem;color:#1c1c2e;line-height:1.65;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:keep-all}
.pj-period{font-size:.73rem;color:#6b7b8d;margin-top:3px}
.pj-acts{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;align-items:flex-end}
.pj-role{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;background:#1a8b78;color:#fff;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:500;padding:2px 9px;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap}
.pj-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;font-size:.7rem;color:#1a8b78;font-weight:500;text-decoration:none;padding:2px 8px;border:1px solid #1a8b78;border-radius:4px;white-space:nowrap;transition:background .2s,color .2s}
.pj-link:hover{background:#1a8b78;color:#fff}
.pj-link svg{width:10px;height:10px;fill:currentColor;flex-shrink:0}

/* AWARD */
.aw-card{background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e6f5f3 0%,#fff 60%);border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;padding:22px 24px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:18px}
.aw-icon{width:46px;height:46px;background:#1a8b78;border-radius:50%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0}
.aw-icon svg{width:22px;height:22px;fill:#fff}
.aw-text h3{font-size:.95rem;font-weight:500;color:#0d1f35}
.aw-text p{font-size:.8rem;color:#6b7b8d;margin-top:2px}

/* CERTS & LANGUAGE */
.cl-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(150px,1fr));gap:10px}
.cl-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:8px;padding:14px 16px}
.cl-card h3{font-size:.88rem;font-weight:500;color:#0d1f35}
.cl-card p{font-size:.75rem;color:#6b7b8d;margin-top:2px;line-height:1.5}
.cl-card.lang{border-color:#1a8b78;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e6f5f3 0%,#fff 80%)}
.lang-bdg{display:inline-block;background:#0d1f35;color:#fff;font-size:.85rem;font-weight:700;padding:3px 8px;border-radius:5px;letter-spacing:.05em;margin-bottom:4px}

/* ACTIVITIES */
.conf-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin-bottom:20px}
.conf-card{border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;box-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.06);cursor:zoom-in;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}
.conf-card:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.conf-img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:center 10%;display:block}
.conf-cap{padding:12px 14px}
.conf-cap .c-badge{display:inline-block;background:#1a8b78;color:#fff;font-size:.7rem;font-weight:600;padding:2px 8px;border-radius:4px;letter-spacing:.06em;margin-bottom:5px}
.conf-cap p{font-size:.78rem;color:#6b7b8d;line-height:1.5}
.poster-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:12px}
.poster-card{background:#fff;border:1px solid #dce8e5;border-radius:10px;overflow:hidden;cursor:zoom-in;transition:box-shadow .2s,transform .2s}
.poster-card:hover{box-shadow:0 6px 20px rgba(26,139,120,.12);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.poster-thumb{width:100%;aspect-ratio:3/4;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;display:block}
.poster-info{padding:8px 10px}
.poster-info p{font-size:.68rem;color:#1c1c2e;line-height:1.45;overflow-wrap:break-word;word-break:break-word}

/* FOOTER */
footer{background:#0d1f35;color:rgba(255,255,255,.4);text-align:center;padding:28px 20px;font-size:.78rem;letter-spacing:.05em}

/* RESPONSIVE */
@media(max-width:700px){
  header{padding:44px 20px 38px}
  .h-inner{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .prof-img{display:block;margin:0 auto 18px;width:120px;height:120px}
  .h-name{text-align:center;font-size:2.2rem}
  .h-name em{text-align:center}
  .h-sub{text-align:center}
  .h-tags{justify-content:center}
  .c-list{align-items:flex-start;margin-top:20px}
  .c-item{justify-content:flex-start}
  main{padding:44px 18px 60px}
  .tl-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:4px}
  .tl-d{padding-top:0}
  .sk-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .pj-card{grid-template-columns:1fr;row-gap:8px}
  .pj-acts{flex-direction:row;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .conf-row{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .conf-img{aspect-ratio:4/3}
  .poster-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .cl-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:400px){
  .cl-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .poster-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}

</style>
</head>
<body>

<!-- LIGHTBOX -->
<div class="lb" id="lb" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">

    <img id="lb-img" src="" alt="확대 이미지"/>
  </div>
</div>

<!-- HEADER -->
<header>
  <div class="h-inner">
    <img id="img-prof" class="prof-img" src="" alt="이지은 프로필 사진"/>

        <span class="h-tag">식품</span>
      </div>
    </div>

      </div>

        <span>010-5571-6735</span>
      </div>
      <div class="c-item">
        <svg class="ci" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12 2C8.1 2 5 5.1 5 9c0 5.3 7 13 7 13s7-7.7 7-13c0-3.9-3.1-7-7-7zm0 9.5c-1.4 0-2.5-1.1-2.5-2.5S10.6 6.5 12 6.5 14.5 7.6 14.5 9 13.4 11.5 12 11.5z"/></svg>
        <span>부산광역시 해운대구</span>
      </div>
      <div class="c-item">
        <svg class="ci" viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M9 11H7v2h2v-2zm4 0h-2v2h2v-2zm4 0h-2v2h2v-2zm2-7h-1V2h-2v2H8V2H6v2H5a2 2 0 0 0-2 2v14a2 2 0 0 0 2 2h14a2 2 0 0 0 2-2V6a2 2 0 0 0-2-2zm0 16H5V9h14v11z"/></svg>
        <span>1999.12.20 (만 26세)</span>
      </div>

</header>

<main>

<!-- 학력사항 -->
<section class="sec">
  <div class="sh"><h2>학력사항</h2><div class="sh-line"></div></div>
  <div>
    <div class="tl-row">
      <div class="tl-d">2024.03 — 2026.02</div>
      <div class="tl-b"><h3>국립부경대학교 · 석사</h3><p>식품영양학과 · 부산</p><span class="bdg">4.41 / 4.5</span></div>
    </div>
    <div class="tl-row">
      <div class="tl-d">2020.03 — 2024.02</div>
      <div class="tl-b"><h3>국립부경대학교 · 학사</h3><p>식품영양학과 · 부산</p><span class="bdg">3.86 / 4.5</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 경력사항 -->
<section class="sec">
  <div class="sh"><h2>경력사항</h2><div class="sh-line"></div></div>
  <div>
    <div class="tl-row">
      <div class="tl-d">2026.03.10 —<br>현재</div>
      <div class="tl-b"><h3>국립수산과학원</h3><p>식품안전가공과 · 석사 후 연구원</p></div>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 보유 기술 -->
<section class="sec">
  <div class="sh"><h2>보유 기술</h2><div class="sh-line"></div></div>
  <div class="sk-grid">
    <div class="sk-card">
      <h3>HPLC</h3><p class="sk-desc">High Performance Liquid Chromatography</p>
      <div class="sk-bar"><div class="sk-fill" style="width:90%"></div></div>
      <p class="sk-lv">기능 대부분 활용 가능</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sk-card">
      <h3>LC-MS</h3><p class="sk-desc">Liquid Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry</p>
      <div class="sk-bar"><div class="sk-fill" style="width:90%"></div></div>
      <p class="sk-lv">기능 대부분 활용 가능</p>
    </div>
    <div class="sk-card">
      <h3>GC-MS</h3><p class="sk-desc">Gas Chromatography–Mass Spectrometry</p>
      <div class="sk-bar"><div class="sk-fill" style="width:55%"></div></div>
      <p class="sk-lv">일부 기능 활용 가능</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 논문 -->
<section class="sec">
  <div class="sh"><h2>논문</h2><div class="sh-line"></div></div>
  <div class="paper">
    <h3>Lipidomic Profiling–Based Identification of Novel Quality Markers Reflecting Freshness Changes in Triploid Oysters</h3>
    <div class="pmeta">
      <span class="pdate">2026.02</span>
      <a class="plink" href="https://m.riss.kr/search/download/FullTextDownload.do?control_no=40e7a0fb55e0a5deffe0bdc3ef48d419&p_mat_type=be54d9b8bc7cdb09&p_submat_type=f1a8c7a1de0e08b8&fulltext_kind=a8cb3aaead67ab5b&t_gubun=&convertFlag=&naverYN=&outLink=&nationalLibraryLocalBibno=&searchGubun=true&colName=bib_t&DDODFlag=&loginFlag=1&url_type=&query=Lipidomic+Profiling" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 19H5V5h7V3H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7h-2v7zM14 3v2h3.59l-9.83 9.83 1.41 1.41L19 6.41V10h2V3h-7z"/></svg>링크</a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="paper">
    <h3>The Influence of Solvent Choice on the Extraction of Bioactive Compounds from Asteraceae: A Comparative Review</h3>
    <div class="pmeta">
      <span class="pdate">2024.10</span>
      <a class="plink" href="https://doi.org/10.3390/foods13193151" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 19H5V5h7V3H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7h-2v7zM14 3v2h3.59l-9.83 9.83 1.41 1.41L19 6.41V10h2V3h-7z"/></svg>링크</a>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>

<!-- 참여과제 -->
<section class="sec">
  <div class="sh"><h2>참여과제</h2><div class="sh-line"></div></div>
  <div class="pj-list">
    <div class="pj-card">
      <span class="pj-org">한국연구재단</span>
      <div class="pj-body">
        <p class="pj-title">해양 미세플라스틱의 어류내 축적에 따른 위해성 평가</p>
        <p class="pj-period">2024.09.01 — 2025.08.31</p>
      </div>
      <div class="pj-acts">
        <span class="pj-role">책임연구원</span>
        <a class="pj-link" href="https://n.news.naver.com/mnews/article/082/0001288017?sid=102" target="_blank" rel="noopener"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M19 19H5V5h7V3H5a2 2 0 00-2 2v14a2 2 0 002 2h14a2 2 0 002-2v-7h-2v7zM14 3v2h3.59l-9.83 9.83 1.41 1.41L19 6.41V10h2V3h-7z"/></svg>링크</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="pj-card">
      <span class="pj-org">환경부</span>
      <div class="pj-body">
        <p class="pj-title">섬 야생생물 유래 천연물 (지표/기능 성분) 소재화</p>
        <p class="pj-period">2024.01.01 — 2025.12.31</p>
      </div>

<script>
(function() {
  /* ── image data ───────────────────────────────────────────── */
  var D = {};
  D.prof = '';
  D.imbc = '';
  D.ksfs = '';
  D.p0   = '';
  D.p1   = '';
  D.p2   = '';
  D.p3   = '';

  /* ── set image sources ────────────────────────────────────── */
  function si(id, key) {
    var el = document.getElementById(id);
    if (el && D[key]) el.src = 'data:image/jpeg;base64,' + D[key];
  }
  si('img-prof', 'prof');
  si('img-imbc', 'imbc');
  si('img-ksfs', 'ksfs');
  si('img-p0',   'p0');
  si('img-p1',   'p1');
  si('img-p2',   'p2');
  si('img-p3',   'p3');

  /* ── profile photo lightbox ───────────────────────────────── */
  var profImg = document.getElementById('img-prof');
  if (profImg) {
    profImg.addEventListener('click', function() { openLb(profImg.src); });
  }

  /* ── activity card lightbox ──────────────────────────────── */
  document.querySelectorAll('[data-lb]').forEach(function(card) {
    card.addEventListener('click', function() {
      var img = card.querySelector('img');
      if (img && img.src) openLb(img.src);
    });
  });

  /* ── lightbox core ───────────────────────────────────────── */
  var lb    = document.getElementById('lb');
  var lbImg = document.getElementById('lb-img');
  var lbX   = document.getElementById('lb-x');

  function openLb(src) {
    lbImg.src = src;
    lb.classList.add('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
  }
  function closeLb() {
    lb.classList.remove('open');
    document.body.style.overflow = '';
    setTimeout(function() { lbImg.src = ''; }, 300);
  }

  lbX.addEventListener('click', closeLb);
  lb.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === lb) closeLb(); });
  document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e) { if (e.key === 'Escape') closeLb(); });
})();
</script>
